summary: Aprea Therapeutics filed a Form 8-K with Items 2.02 (Results of Operations and Financial Condition), 8.01 (Other Events), and 9.01 (Financial Statements and Exhibits). The filing includes a press release on Q1 2026 financial results and a corporate presentation update. It mentions an oversubscribed $30M private placement closed, cash of $46.5M, and ongoing clinical trial progress. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation event is announced; this is a routine earnings and operational update.
